basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old robotics enthusiast based in Berlin, Germany. By day, I work as a junior robotics engineer at a tech startup, and by night, I'm often diving into the latest in AI and automation on Reddit. I'm single and enjoy exploring new cultures and cuisines during my free time. My online presence is typically more active in the evenings and weekends when I have time to unwind and connect with fellow tech aficionados. I'm not a fan of flaky interactions, whether in real life or online, and I appreciate straightforward communication.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering and have been fascinated by robotics since my high school years. I frequently attend workshops and online courses to keep up with the latest innovations. My expertise is largely self-taught, supplemented by formal education and hands-on experience at work.
